description: Defines the WinDnsSystemSettings structure and related functions for Windows DNS configuration management, including DNS server addresses, search lists, devolution settings, and policies.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings
classes.description: Represents Windows DNS system configuration including DNS servers, search lists, devolution settings, and policies.

classes.name: DevolutionSetting
classes.description: Encapsulates devolution configuration with optional enabled and level parameters.

methods.name: IsStatelessDiscoveryAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address matches IPv6 stateless discovery address pattern.

methods.name: GetAllNameservers
methods.description: Retrieves all configured DNS nameservers excluding stateless discovery addresses.
